title: 12-Week Autoregulated Hypertrophy System
subtitle: Six training days per week with strength, hypertrophy, power, athleticism, mobility, flexibility, and fatigue management.
guardrails: This program assumes an experienced, healthy adult with sound exercise technique. It is not injury rehabilitation or medical care.
Stop for sharp, radiating, or escalating pain. A pain score at or above the configured threshold triggers a modification warning and load reduction.
Use drop sets, rest-pause, and myo-reps only where programmed, primarily on stable isolation work. Do not add them to heavy compound lifts.
End power and sprint work when speed, jump height, landing control, or mechanics clearly deteriorate.
Week 12 uses controlled 3 to 5 rep checks near RPE 8, not true one-repetition maximum attempts or grinders.
